scope_note: Vendredi n°261, dated Friday 20 October 1995 on its pages, after the Convention nationale of 14 October 1995. Imported: the results of the members' vote (PDF p. 10), the composition of the secrétariat national approved by the conseil national (PDF p. 9) and a dated item of 18 October 1995 (PDF p. 14). The issue prints no day for the members' vote. An issue of the Parti socialiste's weekly, a party record for its own offices, as digitized and served by the Fondation Jean-Jaurès's Centre d'archives socialistes (the party's foundation archive). The stored PDF is the file the archive's public document viewer loads for this catalogue record; its OCR text layer was read and quotations are kept to passages whose OCR reads cleanly.

rows.text: The issue prints the 'Résultats du vote': 102 999 registered and a participation of 66,36 %; to question n°1, 'Souhaitez-vous que Lionel JOSPIN devienne Premier Secrétaire du Parti Socialiste ?', 94,16 % yes, 2,07 % no and 3,77 % abstention.

The issue reports that, 'après que le poste de Premier secrétaire a été attribué par le vote des militants', the conseil national approved Lionel Jospin's proposals, and the secrétariat national it lists opens 'Lionel JOSPIN, Premier secrétaire'.

locator.item: paragraph after the address and the list that follows

rows.text: The issue reports that a delegation of the FLNKS 'a rencontré, mercredi 18 octobre, Lionel Jospin, Premier secrétaire du Parti socialiste'.

locator.item: FLNKS delegation communiqué, lower-left column, dated '18 octobre'; not the adjacent '17 octobre' items
